findings.description: Recommendation to raise contrast ratio of flagged text without specifying element selector, page URL or specific instance count.
Recommendation to add descriptive alt text to images without referencing specific image selectors or pages.
Recommendation to give custom controls an accessible name and correct role without naming the control selector, page or instance count.
Recommendation to expose structure using native semantic elements before ARIA without specifying which elements or pages are affected.
Recommendation to add a skip link or wrap repeated navigation in a landmark without identifying the specific element, page or selector.
Recommendation to order headings without skipping levels without referencing which heading elements or pages need adjustment.
Recommendation to replace landmark containers with semantic elements and give remaining containers meaningful class names, but no specific selector or page is named.
Generic recommendation to add missing security headers site‑wide without naming the specific header(s) or pages lacking them.
Recommendation to add missing Schema.org properties to flagged entities without specifying which properties, entity types or pages are affected.
